```{r server, include=FALSE}
server<- function(input, output, session){

# Time frame set up
start_date <- as.Date("2026-10-01")
time_step_lengths <- c(0, 3, 3, 6)

#Inflow scenario set up
possible_inflows <- c(2.177, 5.142, 5.934)
inflow <- sample(possible_inflows, 1)

# Initial state for initial message
current_storage <- 5.1
current_elevation <- 3517
current_date <- reactiveVal(start_date)

# Initial message
start_description <- 
  HTML(
              paste0("The Current Date is: ", format(start_date, "%B %d"),
             "<br/>The Current Storage of Lake Powell is: ", current_storage," MAF",
             "<br/>The Current Elevation of Lake Powell is: ", current_elevation," ft.",
             "<br/>The Current Storage of Lake Powell above the protection elevation is ", round(current_storage - 4.215805, digits = 2), " MAF",
             
             "<br/><br/> Make operating decisions for the next 3 months."
              )
    )
observeEvent(TRUE,{  
  showModal(
    modalDialog(title = "Welcome!", 
                uiOutput("instructions_modal"),
                start_description)
  )
}, once = TRUE)

submitted <- reactiveVal(
data.frame(release = 0, add_flow = 0, time_step = 0)
  )

# Defines projection as a value reactive to submitted
projection <- reactive({
  req(submitted()$time_step > 0)
  choices <- submitted()
  
    time_idx <- max(choices$time_step) + 1

    result<- fPowellGameDataWrangle(
        Inflow = inflow,
        Inflow_Time = sum(time_step_lengths),
        Release = choices$release,
        Release_Time = time_step_lengths[1:time_idx],
        Add_Release = choices$add_flow,
        Add_Time = time_step_lengths[1:time_idx],
        Storage_Data = hydrodata,
        start_date = start_date
      )
    
    
      # Checks if Powell is empty
      if (identical(result, "crashed")) {
        showModal(
          modalDialog(
            title = "Empty!",
            "Lake Powell is empty! It's Active Storage is zero!",
            easyClose = FALSE,
            footer = actionButton("restart_button","Try Again")
            )
        )
      return(NULL)
      }
  result
})



##### When Next button is pushed
  #Stores input values after next page button is pushed
  observeEvent(input$next_step, {
     print(paste(
    "\nNEXT STEP\n",
    "submitted time_step:",
    max(submitted()$time_step),
    "\n"
  ))
    
    current <- submitted()
    
    new_choice <- data.frame(
      release = as.numeric(input$release),
      add_flow = as.numeric(input$add_flow),
      time_step = max(current$time_step) + 1
    )
    # If the user does not input something, assume 0
    new_choice[is.na(new_choice)]<- 0
    
    submitted(
      rbind(current, new_choice)
    )
    
    # Clears Input Boxes
    updateTextInput(session, "release", value = "")
    updateTextInput(session, "add_flow", value = "")
  
  })

  
  # Modal logic
  observeEvent(projection(),{
    req(length(submitted()$time_step) > 0)
    result <- projection() 
    print(paste(
  "NEXT_STEP SECOND OBSERVER:",
  max(submitted()$time_step),
  "\n"
))
    # Shows end of game summary if at the end of the time horizon
    if (max(submitted()$time_step) == length(time_step_lengths) - 1){
  
      current_storage <- result$storage[[length(result$storage)]] / 1000000
      current_elevation <- result$elevation[[length(result$elevation)]]
      current_date(max(result$datetime))
      
      # Calculates year to date values and filters to most recent
      result_filtered <- filter(result, label == "With Additional Release")
      ytd_release <- sum(result_filtered$outflow)
      ytd_inflow <- sum(result_filtered$inflow)
      
       end_description<-
        HTML(
          paste0("Congratulations! You've reached the end of the water year and the game! <br/>",
            "The Current Date is: ", format(current_date(), "%B %d"),
             "<br/>The storage of Lake Powell at the end of the water year is: ", round(current_storage, digits = 1), " MAF",
             "<br/>The elevation of Lake Powell at the end of the water year is: ", current_elevation, " ft.",
            "<br/>The Current Storage of Lake Powell above the protection elevation is ", round(current_storage - 4.215805, digits = 2), " MAF",
             "<br/><br/>The total water released from Lake Powell this water year was: ",
            ytd_release, " MAF",
            "<br/>The total inflow to Lake Powell this water year was: ",
            round(ytd_inflow, digits = 2), " MAF"
             )
        )
       
      showModal(
        modalDialog(
          title = "Congratulations!", 
          end_description,
          plotOutput("projection_plot"),
          easyClose = FALSE,
          footer = actionButton("restart_button", "Try Again")
        )
      )
  } 
  # Checks if Powell hits minimum power pool
  else if (any(result$elevation <= 3490, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      showModal(
        modalDialog(
          title = "Minimum Power Pool!",
          "Lake Powell hit minimum power pool! The reservoir's elevation was too low to generate power!",
          easyClose = FALSE,
          footer = actionButton("restart_button", "Try Again")
        )
      )
    }
    
    # Checks if Powell hits 3500
    else if(any(result$elevation <= 3500, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      showModal(
        modalDialog(
          title = "Below Protection Elevation!",
          "Lake Powell is below the Final EIS Protection Elevation (3500 ft)!",
          easyClose = FALSE,
          footer = actionButton("next_modal", "Continue")
        )
      )
    }
    # Shows end of time step message
    else{
      current_storage <- result$storage[[length(result$storage)]] / 1000000
      current_elevation <- result$elevation[[length(result$elevation)]]
      
      current_date(max(result$datetime))
      
      title <- paste0("Current Date: ", format(current_date(), "%B %d"))
      
      description<-
        HTML(
          paste0("The Current Date is: ", format(current_date(), "%B %d"),
             "<br/>The Current Storage of Lake Powell is: ", round(current_storage, digits = 1), " MAF",
             "<br/>The Current Elevation of Lake Powell is: ", current_elevation, " ft.",
             "<br/>The Current Storage of Lake Powell above the protection elevation is ", round(current_storage - 4.215805, digits = 2), " MAF",
             "<br/><br/> Make operating decisions for the next ", time_step_lengths[max(submitted()$time_step + 2)], # +2 because of 0 time_step_length and we're trying to look at next time_step
             " months."
             )
        )
      showModal(
        modalDialog(title = title, description)        
      )
    }
  })
  
  
  # Shows Pop up message if a warning modal came up and was closed
    observeEvent(input$next_modal, {
      removeModal() #Removes warning modals
      
      result <- projection()
      
      current_storage <- result$storage[[length(result$storage)]] / 1000000
      current_elevation <- result$elevation[[length(result$elevation)]]
      time_step_idx <- max(submitted()$time_step)
      current_date(max(result$datetime))
      
      title <- paste0("Current Date: ", format(current_date(), "%B %d"))
      
      description<-
        HTML(
          paste0("The Current Date is: ", format(current_date(), "%B %d"),
             "<br/>The Current Storage of Lake Powell is: ", round(current_storage, digits = 1), " MAF",
             "<br/>The Current Elevation of Lake Powell is: ", current_elevation, " ft.",
             "<br/>The Current Storage of Lake Powell above the protection elevation is ", round(current_storage - 4.215805, digits = 2), " MAF",
             
             "<br/><br/> Make operating decisions for the next ", time_step_lengths[time_step_idx + 2], 
             " months."
             )
        )
      
      showModal(
        modalDialog(title = title, description)        
      )
    })  

# Restarts app if the user clicks the restart button
observeEvent(input$restart_button,{
  restart_app()
  })      

#Plots Projection
    key_elev_df <- data.frame(elevation = c(3490, 3500), label = c("Minimum Power Pool: 3.7 MAF","Final EIS Protection Elevation: 4.2 MAF"))
    output$projection_plot <- renderPlot({
      req(length(submitted()$time_step) > 1)
      req(current_date() == max(projection()$datetime))
      
      fplotprojection(projection(), key_elev_df)
      })
      
    #Updates current state text
    output$current_state <- renderUI({
      #Pulls reactive projection to static values
      req(length(submitted()$time_step) > 1)
      req(current_date() == max(projection()$datetime))
      current_proj <- projection()
       print(paste(
    "RENDERING STATE:",
    "submitted step =", max(submitted()$time_step),
    "projection final storage =",
    tail(current_proj$storage, 1)
  ))
      
      current_storage <- current_proj$storage[[length(current_proj$storage)]] / 1000000
      current_elevation <- current_proj$elevation[[length(current_proj$elevation)]]
      projection_date <- max(current_proj$datetime)
      
      
      #Renders Text
      HTML(paste0(
          "<b>Current Storage: </b>", round(current_storage, digits = 1) , " MAF<br/>",
          "<b>Current Elevation: </b>", current_elevation, " ft<br/>",
          "<b>Current Date: </b>", format(projection_date, "%B %d")
          ))
    })
    
  # Updates Year to Date
    output$ytd <- renderUI({
      req(length(submitted()$time_step) > 1)
      current_proj <- projection()
      
      # Calculates year to date values and filters to most recent
      current_proj_filtered <- filter(current_proj, label == "With Additional Release")
      ytd_release <- sum(current_proj_filtered$outflow) / 1000000
      ytd_inflow <- sum(current_proj_filtered$inflow) / 1000000
      
      # HTML output
      HTML(paste0(
          "<b> Total Release to Date: </b>", round(ytd_release, digits = 1) , " MAF<br/>
          <b> Total Inflow to Powell to Date: </b>", round(ytd_inflow, digits = 1), "MAF"
          ))
    })
  
# Past decisions and inflow table
    past_inputs <-reactive({data.frame(
      date_ranges = fCalculateDateRangeGame(start_date,time_step_lengths[-1]), 
      release = submitted()$release[-1],
      additional_flow = submitted()$add_flow[-1]
    )
    })
    
    
    output$past_decisions <- renderTable({
      req(length(submitted()$time_step) >1)
      past_inputs()})



# Restart App logic
restart_app <- function() {
  updateNumericInput(session, "release", value = "")
  updateNumericInput(session, "add_flow", value = "")
  submitted(data.frame(release = 0, add_flow = 0, time_step = 0))
  
  inflow <- sample(possible_inflows, 1)
  
  removeModal()
  
  #Welcome message
  observeEvent(TRUE,{  
  showModal(
    modalDialog(title = "Welcome!", start_description)
  )
}, once = TRUE)
}

# Can't have the same output in multiple places, so have to define two separate outputs
instructions_content <- function(){
HTML(
  "<h2> Instructions: </h2>
  <br/> 1. Use the given information about Lake Powell's current storage, current elevation, the inflow forecast figure displayed below, and your best judgement to make Lake Powell operating decisions for the next operational period. (For more information about historical Lake Powell release volumes and additional flows from Upper Basin reservoirs, see the context section below the input boxes)
  <br/> 2. Input the following into their respective boxes: The volume of water you have decided to release from Lake Powell over the course of the operational period, and the volume of additional water you have decided to drain from upstream reservoirs.
  <br/> 3. Click Next to lock in your decisions
  <br/> 4. The game simulation will jump to the end of the operational period. A pop-up message will appear telling you the current date, storage, and elevation of Lake Powell based on your decisions. It will also tell you the length of the next operational period.
  <br/> 5. Repeat the previous steps for the following operational periods until the end of the game. The game will end under three conditions:
  <br/>   Lake Powell reaches deadpool (no more water is able to be released throught the Glen Canyon Dam) at any point.
  <br/>   Lake Powell reaches minimum power pool (power is no longer able to be generated throught the Glen Canyon Dam) at any point.
  <br/>   You successfully reach the end of the water year (October of the next year)
  <br/> 6. If you reach a game over condition at any point, you can click the Try Again Button to restart the game with a new inflow scenario.
  <br/> 7. Good Luck!")
}

output$instructions_modal <- renderUI({instructions_content()})
output$instructions_main <- renderUI({instructions_content()})
  
output$figure_title <- renderUI({HTML("<h2>Inflow Scenario Agreement: </h2>")})

output$figure_description <- renderText("This figure shows agreement for 22 different generation methods of ensembles of plausible natural flow hydrology at Lee Ferry in the Colorado River Basin. Natural flow being the hypothetical flow in the system without any consumptive use or reservoir operations. Each bar contains the number of ensembles who’s lowest single year’s flow reaches that low or lower. The inflow scenario used in this game is one of these lowest single year flows. All 22 ensembles agree the Lee Ferry Natural Flow can be as low as 5-6 MAF which is consistent with the 2 lowest years in the historical record( 5.52 MAF in 1977 and 5.93 MAF in 2002). However, half of the ensembles agree the Colorado could see a flow even lower (between 4-5 MAF), and 6 agree that the annual flow could reach as low as between 3-4 MAF.")



}

```

```{r ui, include=FALSE}
ui <- fluidPage(
  uiOutput("instructions_main"),
  
  uiOutput("figure_title"),
  img(src = "images/LowestInflowFigure.png", height = "300px"),
  textOutput("figure_description"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    
    sidebarPanel(
      textInput("release", "Release Volume (MAF): "),
      textInput("add_flow", "Additional Flow (MAF): "),
      actionButton("next_step", "Next"),
      uiOutput("ytd")
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      uiOutput("current_state"),
      plotOutput("projection_plot"),
      tableOutput("past_decisions")
    )  
  ),

  h3("Context: "),
  h3("Assumptions and Data Sources: "),
  h3("Contact Information: ")
)
```
